title: Writing-framework library (capability write-platform)
description: 100 ranked writing/sales/marketing/learning formulas the writer applies with /write --framework=<id>. A framework is a STRUCTURE/formula (composable with --type/--template/--author-style), not a full skeleton. Cross-checks (unique ids, family ∈ families, applies_to_types ∈ write-types ids) are enforced by scripts/cross-tier/validate-write-registries.cjs.

id.description: Unique slug; the value passed to --framework=<id>. May start with a digit (4u-headline, 5e-instructional).

structure.description: The formula's step sequence (e.g. 'Attention → Interest → Desire → Action').

how_to_apply.description: 2-3 sentences: the process + key discipline to apply the framework well (so a writer who doesn't know it can apply it reliably).

example.description: One concrete ≤25-word example of the framework applied.
